desc:
🎨Paint Hide and Seek is a hide-and-seek game where you can paint yourself!

🫣 AS HIDER: Paint yourself to blend in with the environment. DON’T GET CAUGHT!
👀 AS SEEKER: Try to find the hiders and kill them. Once you kill them they’ll join your team. FIND ALL HIDERS!

🪙 Collect coins to get better powers and weapons!

Tags: Hide and Seek, Prop Hunt, FPS, Painting, Hide N Seek, Hide and Die, Seekers, Hiders, Hide as props, Hide & Seek, Free Draw

Game is inspired by "Meccha Chameleon" and "Hide Or Die!" and made by @Poddrans and @jkootooo222 (AaeruzDev)

Controls: 
Q - Ability (Both)
F - Anchor (Hider)
T - Taunt (Hider)
